children: Pegasystems Inc reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue of $393.36M, modestly higher than $381.35M a year earlier, while net income and diluted earnings declined to $14.09M and $0.08 per share, respectively, according to the company's 10-Q filing.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Pega Cloud and subscription services drove modest revenue gains, while annual contract value (ACV) rose about 6% to $1.653B.
Customers continued migrating from maintenance to Pega Cloud, reducing maintenance revenue but increasing cloud subscription adoption and recurring services.
Expanded Pega Cloud adoption and Blueprint prototyping supported enterprise AI decisioning positioning and client engagement.
Company increased cloud operations headcount and marketing and focused R&D on an AI-first strategy and cloud hosting.
Slower ACV growth plus legal and restructuring costs pressured operating cash flow and led to workforce realignment to support AI delivery.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
